scientific_question: Can the seven-trunk MLP's +0.0698 late-horizon gap be closed by unsharing only the complete nonlinear neurons whose functional gradients conflict inside the two shared depth groups?

causal_basis.seven_trunk_finding: The strongest compact LM is +0.0262 CE behind attention-only at 0.5TPP and +0.0698 at 5TPP, missing the strict late-horizon +0.05 gate by only 0.0198 CE.
causal_basis.terminal_conflict_finding: The trained seven-group partition passes common-gradient recovery, so another whole trunk or boundary sweep is not justified; the remaining defect is accumulated endpoint/function mismatch.
causal_basis.shared_sparse_finding: A common dense field plus private 2:4 coordinates reaches 0.8943 output and 0.8199 JVP recovery but leaves +0.7129 fixed CE, proving independent matrix coordinates break cross-layer nonlinear composition.
causal_basis.paired_atom_requirement: For one hidden neuron, c_fc row u_j sets the GELU boundary and c_proj column v_j sets its residual-write direction. They are selected, copied, fit, stored, and materialized as one inseparable atom.
causal_basis.difference_from_rejected_private_ridge: The earlier width-128/256 private-ridge arm appended random atoms to a single weak global trunk across all twelve layers. This plan starts from the near-performing seven-trunk endpoint, modifies only layers 5-11, and replaces selected existing atoms whose within-group functional gradient is layer private.

family.equation: F_l(x)=sum_{j notin A_l} v_{g,j} GELU(p_{l,j} u_{g,j}^T x)+sum_{j in A_l} v_{l,j} GELU(p_{l,j} u_{l,j}^T x), followed by the existing layer-private residual output gain
family.replacement_semantics: Each selected atom replaces both one shared c_fc row and its paired shared c_proj column for that layer. Initialization copies the shared atom exactly, so selection is function preserving before fitting.
family.materialization_note: Shared and private atoms can be folded into ordinary per-layer dense matrices at refresh time. Cached token-time inference retains the dense MLP FLOPs and requires no ambient temporal error buffer.

support_selection.objective: Equal-weight sum of separately normalized clean-output error and symmetric local-perturbation direction error.
support_selection.gradient_definition: Temporarily untie full c_fc/c_proj matrices per layer at the exact seven-trunk endpoint, differentiate the selection objective once, subtract the within-group mean gradient, normalize c_fc-row and c_proj-column residual norms by their group RMS, then score each neuron by the Euclidean norm of the two normalized components.
support_selection.support_rule: For every constrained layer independently, take the deterministic top 128 neuron indices with stable index tie breaking. The support is frozen before fitting and its tensor digest is recorded.
support_selection.causal_limit: This support uses the dense teacher and is an optimistic capacity ceiling, not a deployable training algorithm. Passing authorizes a later causal online acquisition rule; failing closes this selected-atom width without LM training.

fit_protocol.fit_scope: Jointly fit each shared group matrix pair, its existing layer-private pre-GELU/output gains, and only the frozen paired private atom copies. Singleton layers, attention, embeddings, normalization, residual paths, and LM head remain exact dense-teacher values in the splice.
fit_protocol.selection: Restore the lowest full fit objective observed during the registered 800 steps. No support, width, LR, optimizer, step, seed, or threshold sweep.

holdout_measurement.output_metric: explained target energy against the corresponding dense-teacher layer MLP
holdout_measurement.complete_model_splice: Install the two fitted partially unshared groups into a dense-teacher clone, retain exact dense singleton MLPs, and evaluate deterministic CE.

frozen_gates.optimization_health: All values remain finite and the restored state reduces the normalized fit objective by at least 50 percent.

authorization.allowed: Implement, test, preflight, and run exactly this zero-LM-update capacity oracle.
authorization.next_if_pass: Derive a causal short-warmup gradient-conflict acquisition rule for the identical q=128 representation, MFU-gate it, and run 124M/0.5TPP before any 5TPP validation.
authorization.next_if_fail: Reject selected complete-atom unsharing at q=128. Do not run a width sweep; use the per-layer residuals to determine whether the next family needs conditional routing or a different latent function.
not_allowed: language-model training before every frozen gate passes
q=256 fallback or any width sweep
